title: 第25章 谷仓和井第26章 牧草和羊
lines: 抱着古兹和露姆，格林穿过院子，来到了屋后的谷仓前。
这座谷仓看上去有些年头了，它的屋顶是倾斜的，与地面形成了大约45度的夹角。
谷仓的外墙是用红杉木建造的，虽然经过了岁月的洗礼，但依然能够看出木材原本的红色。
然而，当格林走近谷仓时，他注意到外墙的木板缝隙间似乎有一些奇怪的红色液体渗出。
“整天搞这些血，也就视觉冲击大了，除此以外没有其他优点了。”
格林对于牧场的氛围开始感到不满，满目红色，搞得他有点视觉疲劳了，虽然格林没有感觉累就是了。
“格林，那边有一个井。”
古兹指了指远处，那是一口六边形的井。
放下古兹和露姆，格林走到井边，明明是一口井，里面却有着一股炽热的气息传来。
确定井没有什么陷阱后，格林试着摇动转柄，看看能打上什么东西上来。
随着井轴转动，一个木桶装着一个晴天娃娃上来了，晴天娃娃也有着烧焦的痕迹。
又打了几次，没有新东西，格林在确定没有什么特殊魔法之后开始研究晴天娃娃，发现是一个普通的娃娃。
好嘛，自己白忙活了。
“去谷仓里面看看吧。”
格林提议道，他就不信那么大一个谷仓没有好东西，爆点装备也好啊。
走进了谷仓，格林就看到了很劲爆的东西：腹部膨胀至透明的雌性牛形生物，体内可见数十个胎儿以不同发育阶段蠕动。
天花板垂落红色脐带状的干草，末端连着猪胎儿干尸。
“yeee～哎！
古兹、露姆不要进来，里面的东西有点恶心，我处理一下。”
“真的吗？”
古兹从格林的腰间看去，然后立刻点头，“去吧去吧。”
“哼嗯？”
（什么东西？）
露姆探头，露姆回头，露姆点头。
“哼哼！”
（去吧去吧！
然后格林就走进了谷仓，在走进去之前瞄了一眼铁皮人，铁皮人已经牵制了怪物十几分钟。
铁皮人发现了怪物的脑袋不太聪明，于是在主屋那里秦王绕柱跑，怪物时不时吐出几个骨刺，可惜根本破不了铁皮人的防。
在确定那个怪物和铁皮人都不会过来之后，格林拿着剑就杀了进去。
他已经确定了，这里没有高阶及以上的怪物，那里面的怪物也就那个母牛更强。
但是也只有中阶，完全可以乱杀。
母牛也发现了他，发出了某种咩咩的声音，格林听不懂，也懒得理会。
红色的光芒缠绕着剑身，格林一剑劈了过去，巨大的母牛躺在地上根本无力躲闪，直接被劈碎了。
母牛怪物“嘭”
的一声炸开，里面的畸形胎儿飞出，或滚、或爬、或走地冲向了格林。
“吼吼，非但没有逃跑，反而向我走过来了吗？”
格林的剑闪烁着鲜艳的红色，生命力不断转化为强大的魔力。
有一说一，黑魔法真的很强，就是可惜太费命了。
也就格林是不死者了，换其他人这样玩早没了，要不然就是变成异教徒了。
讲个好笑的，劈开一个个冲过来的怪物，格林刚才在玩水果忍者，现在估计已经几十连斩了。
已经裂开的母牛怪物又发出了声响，伴随着刺耳的尖啸，那些天花板吊着的胎儿干尸，并且在坠落途中竟诡异地重组，化作数十具白骨刺猬朝格林弹射而来。
剑刃横扫，骨刺却在触及红光时化作齑粉，格林顺势踏地跃起，剑尖直贯母牛眉心。
怪物头颅炸裂的刹那，格林凌空旋转，血色剑气将飞溅的畸形胎儿尽数绞碎成血雾。
content_en:
Holding Guz and Lum in his arms, Green walked through the yard and came to the barn behind the house.
The barn looked to be old, with its roof sloping at an angle of about 45 degrees to the ground.
The exterior walls of the barn are made of redwood. Although it has been baptized by the years, the original red color of the wood can still be seen.
However, as Green approached the barn, he noticed what seemed to be a strange red liquid seeping out from between the cracks in the wood panels on the exterior wall.
"Doing all this blood all day long only has a great visual impact. Other than that, there are no other advantages."
Green began to feel dissatisfied with the atmosphere of the ranch. The red color in his eyes made him a little visual fatigue, although Green did not feel tired.
"Green, there's a well over there."
Guz pointed to the distance, which was a hexagonal well.
Putting down Guzi and Lum, Green walked to the well. It was obviously a well, but there was a hot breath coming from inside.
After confirming that there were no traps in the well, Green tried to shake the handle to see what could come up.
As the shaft of the well rotated, a wooden barrel came up containing a Sunny Day doll. The Sunny Day doll also had burnt marks.
After beating it a few more times, there was nothing new. After confirming that there was no special magic, Green began to study the Sunny Day doll and found that it was an ordinary doll.
Well, I was busy in vain.
"Let's go look inside the barn."
Green suggested, he didn't believe that such a big barn didn't have good stuff, even some explosive equipment.
Entering the barn, Green saw something very exciting: a female cow-shaped creature with an abdomen that was inflated until it was transparent. Dozens of fetuses could be seen squirming in different stages of development inside her body.
Red umbilical cords of hay hang from the ceiling, with mummified pig fetuses attached to the ends.
“yeee~hey!
Guz and Lum, don't come in. The stuff inside is a bit disgusting. I'll take care of it. "
"Really?"
Guz looked from Green's waist, and then nodded immediately, "Go ahead, go ahead."
"Hmm?"
(What thing?)
Lum poked his head in, Lum looked back, and Lum nodded.
"Hmph!"
(Go, go, go!
Then Green walked into the barn and glanced at the Tin Woodman before walking in. The Tin Woodman had already restrained the monster for more than ten minutes.
The Tin Woodman discovered that the monster's head was not very smart, so King Qin ran around the pillar in the main house. The monster spit out a few bone spurs from time to time, but unfortunately it could not break the Tin Woodman's defense.
After making sure that neither the monster nor the Tin Woodman would come, Green took his sword and went in.
He has determined that there are no monsters of high level or above here, and the monster inside is only stronger than the cow.
But it's only at the middle level, and it can be killed at will.
The cow also noticed him and made some kind of bleating sound that Green didn't understand and didn't bother to pay attention to.
Red light wrapped around the sword body, and Green slashed it with his sword. The huge cow lay on the ground, unable to dodge, and was directly chopped into pieces.
Cow Monster "Bang"
There was an explosion, and the deformed fetus inside flew out, rolling, crawling, or walking towards Green.
"Hoho, instead of running away, did you actually come towards me?"
Green's sword flashes bright red, and his life force is constantly transformed into powerful magic.
There is a saying, black magic is really powerful, but unfortunately it is too life-consuming.
In other words, Green is an immortal. If anyone else had played like this, he would have died, otherwise he would have become a heretic.
To put it in a funny way, Green was playing Fruit Ninja just now, and now he has probably killed dozens of monsters in a row.
The split cow monster made another sound, accompanied by a piercing scream. The fetal mummies hanging from the ceiling reorganized strangely during the fall, turning into dozens of white-bone hedgehogs and ejected towards Green.
The sword blade swept across, but the bone spurs turned into powder when it touched the red light. Green jumped up on the ground, and the tip of the sword penetrated the cow's eyebrows.
The moment the monster's head exploded, Green spun in the air, and the bloody sword energy crushed all the flying deformed fetuses into blood mist.
title_en: Chapter 25 Barn and Well Chapter 26 Pasture and Sheep
